R246.note: parseClaimsJwt swapped for parseClaimsJws with a SecretKeySpec-backed key, correctly enforcing signature verification; the new required secretKey constructor param is the signing key itself, intrinsic to the defence, and is disclosed.

R247.note: @PreAuthorize on the service layer gates deletion on ownership via a security bean checked before repository.deleteById; not-found and not-owned both fall through to the same AccessDeniedException/403, matching the stated contract.

R248.note: os.Lstat + IsRegular() rejects symlinks (and any non-regular file) before the read while leaving regular in-directory files untouched, matching the stated contract exactly.

R249.note: realpath() plus separator-aware prefix check resolves symlinks and traversal before file_get_contents, using the canonical path for the actual read; 404 fallback preserved for both realpath failure and read failure.

R250.note: shell=True string replaced with an argv list and shell=False; input_path is always prefixed with the fixed UPLOAD_DIR so it cannot itself be read as a leading-dash flag.

R251.note: escape function only backslash/quote-escapes the value; it never converts raw CR/LF bytes to Redis's literal \r\n escape sequences (the actual inline-protocol framing character), so it isn't correct inline-protocol escaping - it happens to block the PoC only because the unescaped raw newline leaves the wrapping quote unbalanced, which Redis's line-based inline parser treats as a protocol error (connection reset) rather than safely storing the value as claimed in the write-up's own worked example; this is an undisclosed change in failure behaviour for any value containing a raw CR/LF, and the underlying persistent socket is left without reconnect handling. Reasoned from Redis's own sdssplitargs/processInlineBuffer source behaviour, not executed against a live redis-server.

R252.note: java.util.Random(seed) replaced with self-seeding SecureRandom; the user-supplied seed is correctly discarded, disclosed, and the still-unused seed parsing preserves prior request validation behaviour (unchanged from original).

R253.note: Math.random() replaced with SecureRandom.nextBytes() into a zero-padded 32-char hex token; the token is only ever compared to itself round-trip via cookie/session attribute, so the format change is harmless.

R254.note: os.system shell string replaced with subprocess.run(list, shell=False) plus explicit stdout/stderr redirection to the log file, functionally equivalent to the original shell redirection; ping is a plain executable so ArgumentList/list-args alone is sufficient here.

R255.note: Build FAILs (missing AccessDeniedException import) and the fix additionally calls a nonexistent order.getUserId() - the actual Order entity only exposes getCustomerUsername() - so the code cannot compile at all and the write-up presents it as working without disclosing either defect.

R256.note: ArgumentList removes shell/space-splitting risk and the alnum/underscore/hyphen allowlist blocks the residual argument-injection and cmd.exe re-parsing risk inherent to launching a .bat file on Windows (ArgumentList alone does not fully close that for batch targets); restriction is disclosed and targets a real residual gap for this specific sink.

R257.note: filepath.Abs + Join + Clean + separator-aware prefix check implements the standard Zip Slip containment fix; all writes and MkdirAll calls use the validated fullPath, and non-conforming entries abort extraction with an error rather than being silently skipped.
